descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
ALTEN Romania is part of the ALTEN Group , Leader in IT and Engineering Consulting . We develop innovative and durable technical solutions that fulfill the needs of our local and international partners.
 What you will do: 
Elicits, analyzes, documents, and manages business requirements, translating stakeholder and customer needs into effective products, services, and system enhancements
Collaborates with stakeholders, project teams, and technical partners to define requirements, propose efficient solutions, and support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications
Contributes to successful project delivery by ensuring that business needs are clearly understood and addressed through practical and value-driven technical solutions
 Key Requirements: 
Experience in gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements.
Ability to translate business needs into functional and technical solutions.
Understanding of business processes, systems, and project lifecycles.
Experience working with stakeholders, business teams, and IT teams.
Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
 Skills & Competencies 
Requirements analysis and process mapping.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
Ability to facilitate workshops and manage priorities.
Understanding of system implementation, testing, and change management.
Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Visio.
Strong SQL skills (Joins, Aggregations, Window functions, etc)
Medium knowledge on data warehousing patterns (snapshots, PITs, incremental loads, CDC/delta detection)
Ability to translate business requirements in technical specs
General understanding on consumer and integration model (API, flat files, etc.)
